An overlay at the bottom shows a boy band photo and a cutout of a male idol. (2) A man in a blue denim shirt is shown from the chest up, listening and reacting with expressions of surprise and amusement to the woman's story. A framed caricature of the hosts is visible behind him. (3) A dark-haired woman in a grey long-sleeved shirt is seen in profile, laughing and occasionally covering her face with her hands as she listens to the anecdote. (4) The scene cuts between the three speakers in the studio. Cartoon bird graphics and sweat drop emojis appear around the blonde woman as she describes her nervous silence. (5) The blonde woman laughs and gestures dramatically, holding a framed picture as she recounts the awkward interaction with the celebrity and the reactions of the staff.
